images.title: Funeral of the respected lamenter Matjoi Plattonen, Suistamo
images.creator: Armas Otto Väisänen
images.medium: Photograph (negative scan)
images.collection: Finnish Heritage Agency, Ethnographic Picture Collection, KK3015:68
images.alt: Black-and-white photograph: men, women and children, many in headscarves, stand around an open coffin covered with cloth and heaped with flowers
images.note: Credit required: photographer, Finnish Heritage Agency. Suistamo was then in Finland; it lies today in the Republic of Karelia, Russia, and Commons files the photograph under 'Funerals in Russia'. It is shown as a lament-tradition record from the Karelian border, not as the Olonets Russian tradition of Barsov. Catalogue: https://museovirasto.finna.fi/Record/museovirasto.6ADAA1D892C7A07B94BF3347401FB1E9. The file in this repository is a scaled-down copy (long side ≤ 1920 px) of the Commons original.
